plan.title: Saved eRFX draft hides Add Attachments

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Apply the setting whose effect on the draft's Add Attachments control is under test.
Apply the additional configuration specified by the test case.
Give the draft a title so it can be saved and found in Drafts.
Configure the draft with a pricing template.
Add the required line item for a valid draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule so the draft is fully configured.
Add the product-provided test participant required for the draft setup.
Create the saved eRFX draft that the case requires.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to reopen the saved draft through the buyer flow.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify the newly saved draft is present in Drafts.
Open the saved draft from the Drafts list.
Assert the Add Attachments control is not offered on the saved draft.
